description: This file defines a React component named ApplicationGroupView. It manages the lifecycle and rendering of a group of applications, handling events such as application activation, device restart, and deinitialization. It also displays dialogs for certain application states and conditionally renders the active application view.

classes.name: ApplicationGroupView
classes.description: A React component that manages a group of applications, including their initialization, event handling, and rendering.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up application group, event observers, and platform-specific class.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Performs cleanup by removing observers, deinitializing the application group, updating state, and calling onDestroy callback.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component, including dialogs for device destruction or deinitialization states, and the active application view.
